idiom_name: Vapor AsyncMiddleware in the responder chain, applied via route groups
implementation_notes: In Vapor the shared security sequence is middleware conforming to AsyncMiddleware, registered globally with app.middleware.use or per route group with app.grouped; it wraps the responder chain and can reject a request before the route handler runs. The base action becomes that middleware plus an Authenticatable user resolved from the request, and business handlers stay plain closures. Registration order is the security order for requests, and the response passes back through the chain in reverse.
pitfalls: Application middleware runs for every route including public ones; use route groups so the security chain is declared where it applies.
Route-specific middleware runs after application middleware, so global error middleware sees a rejection before grouped checks run.
The authenticator must populate request.auth before guardMiddleware and the security middleware execute; the order inside grouped() is the contract.
